|translation='''Title:''' So it didn't smell bad only on the outside.

'''Card text:'''
Sacrifice (lose) one of your creature vehicles. Choose one character at the same location. That character is immune to Exposure, Ice Storm, Frostbite and Gravel Storm this turn.

'''Lore:'''
"Hang on, Luke. It may smell, but… until I get a shelter up… you'll stay warm in here."

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese immunizes one character and has no Ronto extra or Tzizvvt power option.
